phrase.zh: 细看一道光，也能发现新的规律。
phrase.en: Look closely at a line of light to find a new law.

visual.zh: 为塞曼独立创作的光谱拼贴，用马蹄形磁铁、分光器和边缘的细光线表现磁场与光的联系。器具组合与光线位置是艺术表达，不是实验示意图。
visual.en: An original spectral collage for Zeeman uses a horseshoe magnet, spectroscope and fine edge-bound light lines to interpret the connection between magnetism and light. The arrangement is artistic, not an experiment diagram.

background.zh:
塞曼发现，光谱中的细线在磁场影响下会分裂成多条。他与提供理论解释的洛伦兹分享1902年诺贝尔物理学奖。配图用磁铁和分光器呼应这项研究，没有复刻他的实验装置。
1902年物理学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他们研究磁性对辐射现象影响所作出的卓越贡献。
background.en:
Zeeman observed that spectral lines split into several components under a magnetic field. He shared the 1902 Nobel Prize in Physics with Lorentz, whose work provided a theoretical explanation. The magnet and spectroscope evoke this research without reconstructing his apparatus.
1902 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: in recognition of the extraordinary service they rendered by their researches into the influence of magnetism upon radiation phenomena
